items.title: Leaderboard premise
items.detail: Brief cites 0.4413 as top; official page read 31 Oct shows #1 xiaofanhu 0.4544. Brief's 0.3195 is #50 (kpomazi), not the leader.

items.title: Unverified focus scores
items.detail: All nine focus-site scores are USER-REPORTED. No HOLDOUT-DTI or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED value exists for any focus file.

items.title: Label-source conflict in official rules
items.detail: Rules section 2 names USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database labels plus expert-labelled new faults; section 3.3 names the INGENIOUS Great Basin compilation as the training-label source.

items.title: Generative-AI disclosure
items.detail: Rules section 3.2 requires disclosure of generative-AI use in the submission narrative. This lane used AI-assisted coding and analysis; disclosure is needed before any submission.

items.title: Registry scan incomplete
items.detail: 117 of 118 registry rasters checked. 14GEMSDOE GEMS_r5-geom-horse-ensemble failed: registry CRS/transform differs from reference. complete_accessible_scan=false.

items.title: Shipped file differs from measured method
items.detail: E2 emitted 50,000-87,000 dots per holdout fold (about 1.2M cells per quadrant). The full-map run at K=12,198 emitted 33,897 dots on about 5.1M cells. The holdout does not directly measure the shipped TIFF. Cause unexplained (hypothesis: allocator sensitivity to probability spread).

items.title: Template defect
items.detail: vendor/template57/prepare_data.py main() resolves ROOT to vendor/ when run in place. Functions called unchanged with ROOT=repo root. Reported; not forked.

items.title: Missing external inputs
items.detail: data/external/ lacks sgmc_faults_100m.tif, derived_sgmc_faults_100m.tif, trace_segments_utm11.csv, qfault_attributes.csv. Template PIN check fails.

items.title: Unexplained NaN pixels
items.detail: About 1,521 NaN pixels per band inside the footprint are unexplained.

items.title: Two writer paths
items.detail: vendor/gems57/submission_writer.py (fail-closed, 0 slots) and scripts/submission_writer.py (wraps src/gems/submission). The fail-closed path was used for the holdout.

items.title: Literal 70% gate is degenerate
items.detail: A dense lattice captures about 99.7% of any field. The gate is the lab's protocol, not an official rule: the official rules text reviewed (sections 1-3.6 and the start of Appendix A) has no duplicate test. Appendix A chunks 4-6 not read.

items.title: Time budget not re-verified
items.detail: The 2-hour window was not re-checked after the data restore; no fourth experiment was run.
